content_metadata.description: The video explores themes of power, corruption, and moral compromise through the narrative of a President's rise to power and their attempts to escape justice.

qAndA.answer: The President price caps video games, as seen in the game interface screenshot at 0:38.
qAndA.question: What specific action does the President take to score 'easy points' with the public?

qAndA.answer: A hamster named 'Baby Lee.' This is shown in the visual of a space capsule at 0:51.
qAndA.question: What animal does the President consider sending into space?

qAndA.answer: The President reminds them that they are covering up their dirty little secrets, as seen through the visuals of dossiers and documents at 1:13.
qAndA.question: How does the President ensure their team's loyalty when they express dissatisfaction with some of the decisions made?

qAndA.answer: The media publishes articles and social media posts criticizing the President's actions, particularly their handling of gun violence and potential involvement in unethical activities, as seen in the visuals at 1:33.
qAndA.question: What event leads to calls for the President's impeachment?

qAndA.answer: The hostage taker offers gold bricks, as mentioned in the text box at 1:41.
qAndA.question: What bribe does the anonymous hostage taker offer to the President?

activities.description: President giving an election speech, crowd cheering.

characterInteraction.description: The President addresses a cheering crowd, while the narrator explains the situation to the viewer.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The President's words about changing the country for the better are contrasted with the narrator's cynical explanation, highlighting the inherent hypocrisy of power.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Mood transition to a darker, more serious tone as the narrator reveals the President's true intentions.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduction of the President and their goal of changing the US constitution to escape justice.

scenes.title: Scene 1

videoEditingDetails.description: Fade in, background music (upbeat, patriotic), zoom in on world map, transition to game interface with a fade.

activities.description: The President makes various decisions, ranging from seemingly mundane to ethically questionable.

characterInteraction.description: The President interacts with various advisors and world leaders, each offering their own perspective and advice.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The increasing moral ambiguity of the President's actions is underscored by the juxtaposed scenes, culminating in the morally reprehensible choice of aiding a serial killer.

narrativeProgression.description: A montage showcasing the President maneuvering through a series of events and making various decisions, each with its own set of implications.

scenes.title: Scene 2

videoEditingDetails.description: Fast cuts between different game screens, character portraits appearing and disappearing, background music (suspenseful, tense).

activities.description: The President builds their team, manages their team members' loyalty, deals with Christmas bonuses.

characterInteraction.description: The President navigates the complex relationships within their team, using a combination of threats and incentives to ensure their cooperation.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The use of 'Christmas bonuses' from a charity fund highlights the President's cynical manipulation even within their own circle, emphasizing their moral bankruptcy.

narrativeProgression.description: The President assembles a team, deals with internal politics and maintains loyalty through both coercion and rewards.

scenes.title: Scene 3

videoEditingDetails.description: Transition to team management screen, focus on character portraits and relationships, background music continues (suspenseful, tense).

activities.description: The President faces media scrutiny and potential impeachment, deals with a hostage situation, and delivers a speech.

characterInteraction.description: The President's actions are challenged by journalists and the public, while their inner circle remains loyal despite their reservations.
The anonymous hostage taker directly interacts with the President, offering a bribe.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The hostage situation serves as a microcosm of the President's entire term - a crisis born of their own actions, where they exploit the situation for their gain while silencing dissent.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Transition from anxiety to a sense of bleak acceptance as the narrator emphasizes the harsh reality of the political landscape.
Transition back to a sense of urgency and anticipation as the President addresses the nation, their future uncertain.

narrativeProgression.description: The President's actions draw increasing criticism, leading to potential impeachment. The President faces a moral choice in a hostage situation and ultimately addresses the nation, solidifying their grip on power.

scenes.thematicElements: Impeachment, media scrutiny, moral compromises, public perception.
scenes.title: Scene 4

videoEditingDetails.description: Fast cuts between news articles and game screens, background music fades out, replaced by sound of protests, gunshots, and police sirens.

climax.description: The President's address to the nation, reaffirming control and escaping justice.

storylines.description: Highlights the President's journey from election victory to power consolidation and their escape from justice.

trimmingSuggestions.description: Some repetitive examples of the President's decisions could be trimmed for a faster pace.
The Christmas bonus segment could be shortened slightly to focus on more dramatic tension.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: You're the newly elected president and you need to change the United States Constitution to escape justice.
How do you do that? Well, that's fairly obvious, isn't it?
You'll force Congress to support your amendment, get the Supreme Court on your side to initiate a popular vote
and deploy all possible tricks and deception. Some dimwits might even say crimes to win it.
Just don't get impeached before doing all that. And you're golden.
But the road to lifelong immunity is full of pitfalls and you'll need to remember to clean up the daily messes that arise.
Some might even call these distractions presidential duties.
Scorsome easy points by price-capping video games and banning online advertising, but why limit yourself to ads alone?
Let's regulate the whole internet. Our friends in China could use some help with censorship anyway.
Or how about rescuing Russia's president who's been overthrown by his opponent?
Extending a hamster into space is one of the more reasonable choices. Right makes for helping a serial killer escape prison.
Oh, and I almost forgot about discovering you know who's secret nuclear weapon.
Of course your team members may dislike some of your decisions, but it doesn't always hurt to remind them who's helping cover up their dirty little secrets.
Things like gambling, alcohol and domestic violence, just to name a few.

Thugs, hackers, journalists, lawyers. You need a variety of talents and no matter how differently they may feel about the nature of their work, there is no moral dilemma that cannot be solved with a juicy Christmas bonus from our charity fund.
Some might call it morally ambiguous, but others are realists like yourself. This is the world we live in. Why not take the lemons and make some lemonade?
Americans can put their faith in their cute little separation of powers all they want, but no one and I mean no one can resist our methods of persuasion.
And not only because they realize the ethical implications of their actions, but also because deep down they already know nothing can separate power from you.

youtube_description:
​So you are the president and you want to have your own app because somebody did not like your approach toward "the truth"?
​Forget them, you want your own platform with blackjack and … wait!

Have you not heard about the app "This Is the President"?

This game teaches you how to be a "proper" politician. And it is coming to your mobile device today! ​

"This Is the President" is now available on the App Store, Google Play Store and Samsung Galaxy Store.

"This Is the President" is a story-driven mixture of adventure, strategy, and management. It is the year 2020, you are elected to be the President of the United States of America. To escape justice for your past crimes as a shady multi-millionaire businessman, you need to ratify Amendment 28 which would grant lifetime immunity to any President.

There’s only one way out. Change the fabric of the Constitution of the United States by persuading, blackmailing, bribing, and bullying a large part of the political system into granting you lifelong immunity.
